upsets.analysis: Sweden enters as a massive underdog after a 3-0 group-stage loss to France, but knockout football rewards resilience and luck. France's flawless group run masks a slight vulnerability: they conceded a goal to Senegal and relied on early leads. Sweden's best path is a compact low block, exploiting set pieces, and hoping France's stars have an off day. The single-elimination format amplifies variance, but the head-to-head evidence is damning. Plausibility is low, yet not impossible.
key_factors: France potential complacency
Sweden disciplined counter-attack
Knockout variance
upsets.one_liner: Sweden's only hope is a disciplined defensive display and a miracle on the break.
